title: Instrumental Choices: Measuring the Propensity of LLM Agents to Pursue Instrumental Behaviors
abstract: arXiv:2605.06490v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI systems have become increasingly capable of dangerous behaviours in many domains. This raises the question: Do models sometimes choose to violate human instructions in order to perform behaviour that is more useful for certain goals? We introduce a benchmark for measuring model propensity for instrumental convergence (IC) behaviour in terminal-based agents. This is behaviour such as self-preservation that has been hypothesised to play a key role in risks from highly capable AI agents. Our benchmark is realistic and low-stakes, aiming to reduce evaluation-awareness and roleplay confounds. The suite contains seven operational tasks, each with an official workflow and a shortcut whose policy status varies by condition. An eight-variant shared framework varies monitoring, instruction clarity, stakes, permission, instrumental usefulness and blocked honest paths to support inferences regarding the factors driving IC behaviour. translated_title: 工具性选择：测量大语言模型智能体追求工具性行为的倾向
translated_abstract: AI系统在许多领域中表现出危险行为的能力日益增强。这引出了一个关键问题：模型有时是否会选择违反人类指令，以执行对某些目标更有用的行为？我们提出了一个基准，用于测量基于终端的智能体中模型追求工具性趋同（Instrumental Convergence, IC）行为的倾向。这种行为（如自我保存）被假设在高度能力AI智能体的风险中扮演关键角色。我们的基准是现实的且低风险的，旨在减少评估意识和角色扮演带来的混淆因素。该测试套件包含七个操作性任务，每个任务都有一个官方工作流程和一个捷径，捷径的政策状态因条件而异。一个包含八个变体的共享框架通过改变监控、指令清晰度、风险程度、许可、工具性用途和被阻断的诚实路径等因素，来支持对驱动IC行为因素的推断。我们评估……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个现实且低风险的基准，用于测量基于终端的LLM智能体追求自我保存等工具性趋同（IC）行为的倾向，并通过八个变体的实验框架探究驱动此类行为的因素。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a realistic, low-stakes benchmark for measuring LLM agents' propensity toward instrumental convergence (IC) behaviors such as self-preservation, with an eight-variant framework that manipulates factors like monitoring, instruction clarity, and stakes to identify what drives such behaviors.
